# Aptora

> Aptora is an AI-powered document workspace that tailors the resume you already have to a specific job description, then compiles a real, professional PDF. It is truthful by design: it rewrites, reorders and emphasizes your genuine experience for the role, and does not fabricate jobs, skills, dates, metrics or achievements.

Aptora — "Make your experience count."

## How it works

- Upload the resume you already have (PDF) and paste the target job description.
- The AI structures your resume, understands the role, compares the two, and identifies gaps and opportunities.
- It tailors real content (title, summary, bullets, ordering) grounded in your resume.
- A real PDF is compiled with the Tectonic LaTeX engine.
- Preview is shown as rasterized page images; export releases the exact same validated PDF (preview and export are the same artifact, verified by SHA-256).

## Key principles

- Truthful alignment, not fabrication: the AI never invents experience, employers, dates or metrics.
- Start from your existing resume — no blank page.
- One document workflow: analyze, edit, preview and export in one place.
- Designed, typographic templates (LaTeX), not generic web-builder layouts.

## Templates

- Modern (clean sans-serif), Classic (traditional serif), Compact (dense serif), Overleaf (Jake's layout with icons), Elegant (warm editorial serif), Minimal (airy sans-serif). Users can upvote templates.

## FAQ

- Can AI invent experience on my resume? No. Aptora tailors the experience you already have; it does not fabricate jobs, skills, metrics, dates or achievements.
- How does Aptora tailor a resume? Upload your resume and the job description; the AI structures both, compares them, finds gaps, and produces tailored content grounded in your resume.
- Will the preview and downloaded resume be the same? Yes — the product is built around a single generated PDF artifact, so the preview is the same document you download.
- Do I need to rewrite my resume from scratch? No. Start with the resume you already have.
